entry_route.value: Four-year baccalaureate degree in chemical engineering or related science/engineering required; MS is not a prerequisite for PhD admission.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have earned a four-year baccalaureate degree (Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Science in Engineering) in chemical engineering or a related science or engineering discipline, such as chemistry, biochemistry, biological engineering, environmental science, atmospheric science, materials science, mathematics, and physics. An MS is not a prerequisite for admission to the PhD program.
